tools.name: search_medicine
tools.description: Search French medicines (BDPM) by name or active substance and show the ANSM shortage linked to each, plus listed shortages not linked to any medicine that match the query. Medicines in rupture or tension come first. Information only: never use this to recommend a substitute, an alternative or an eq

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Current ANSM shortage status of one medicine, given exactly one of: its CIS code, an ANSM shortage id or a name. tools.name: is_major_therapeutic_interest
tools.description: Whether a medicine, given exactly one of its CIS code or its name, is on the BDPM list of medicines of major therapeutic interest (MITM), with its ATC code. Information only: never use this to recommend a substitute, an alternative or an equivalent medicine, a dosage change or stopping a treatment.

tools.name: get_medicine_info
